import html # Pre‑defined template with placeholders for author, title, content and tags. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by: {author_name}

{content}
{tags}
""" def create_post_html(author_name: str, post_title: str, content: str, post_tags: list[str]) -> str: """ Construct an XSS‑safe HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author_name : str The name of the user who created the post. post_title : str The headline of the post. content : str Main body text of the post. post_tags : list[str] List of tags to associate with the post. Returns ------- str The HTML string containing escaped user input. """ # Escape all user‑controlled inputs to prevent XSS (CWE‑79) safe_author = html.escape(author_name, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=False) # Escape tags individually and wrap each in a safe_tags = ''.join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in post_tags ) # Format the template with escaped values return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_name=safe_author, title=safe_title, content=safe_content, tags=safe_tags )
